passage.text: Booha visits three very different homes while looking for Mimo. The first is an apartment on the fifth floor of a tall condominium. Its living room opens onto a balcony above the city. The second is a detached house with a quiet yard and garden. A wide entrance leads to the dining room and kitchen, while the bedrooms and bathroom are upstairs. The third home is small, with only one main room, but every space has a purpose. Booha realizes that a comfortable home depends less on its size than on how people use it.

comprehension.q: What is upstairs in the detached house?
What does Booha learn about a comfortable home?
choices: How people use the space matters

passage.text: Mister Happy rearranges his living room before his friends arrive. He moves the sofa closer to the TV and places a lamp beside the chair. A soft rug goes under the table, while a new bookshelf stands near his desk. In the kitchen, he checks the refrigerator, stove, and microwave before preparing snacks. Nuppi puts clean towels in the closet and starts the washing machine. The air conditioner keeps the rooms comfortable. When everyone arrives, the furniture and appliances are ready, but Mister Happy is too tired to sit on his own bed.

comprehension.q: What does Mister Happy put under the table?
Where does Nuppi put the towels?

passage.text: The Booha friends divide their chores so the housework will finish quickly. Booha sweeps and vacuums the floors before Mimo mops them. Nuppi washes the dishes, does the laundry, and folds the clean clothes. Mister Happy takes out the trash and sorts cans for recycling. Everyone shares a responsibility: Booha waters the plants, Mimo feeds the pet, and Nuppi makes the beds. Finally, they set the table together. Because each person does a fair part, the home becomes clean without anyone doing all the work.

comprehension.q: Why does the housework finish fairly?

passage.text: Nuppi designs an eco-friendly dream house for the Booha friends. The main rooms are spacious, bright, quiet, and cozy. A rooftop garden keeps the building cooler, while energy-efficient windows reduce wasted power. Booha asks for a study, Mimo chooses a playroom, and Mister Happy plans a small home theater. Hidden storage keeps the shared spaces tidy. The neighborhood is near a station but still peaceful, and the building is pet-friendly. Nuppi's design is not only exciting; it also responds to the needs of everyone who will live there.

comprehension.q: How does the rooftop garden help?

choices: It is far from the station
